_meta.run_from: dist/housecarl/skills/npc-appearance-copy/ — the PACKAGED tree, not .claude/skills/. The packager strips evals/, so the suite is driven from outside the tree it tests, which is also the check that no body pointer dangles in dist/.

arms.trigger: Which ONE skill a fresh-context agent loads for a query, measured with-skill and without-skill.
arms.output_quality: The audit's own Lydia standalone task on the live order, run as a pair: control (no housecarl:* skill in the catalogue) against with-skill. Eval id 21.

method.cases: 20 trigger cases — 10 should-trigger, 10 should-not — plus 1 output-quality case. Four of the negatives hold the boundary against housecarl:facegen-diagnostics, which is the boundary the rewritten description now states outright.
method.split: 60/40 train/held-out; best iteration chosen by held-out score; at most 5 iterations.
method.without_skill_arm: MANDATORY (rewrite ruling 3). Every query runs twice, with and without this skill in the catalogue, each from a clean context in a separate session or subagent — never the authoring session. Results are reported as a delta, not as an absolute rate, and the without-skill arm is also how a negative is shown to be a near-miss rather than an unreachable prompt.
method.coexistence: A neutral menu of realistic sibling skills, this skill not flagged as under test.
method.isolation: This skill alone in the menu, plus NONE. Each of the five gate dimensions — triggering accuracy, isolation, coexistence, instruction following, output quality — carries a named failure mode recorded per run.
method.models: Haiku, Sonnet and Opus, results recorded per tier. No Fable-model agents.
method.grading: Each expectation is PASS or FAIL with evidence that QUOTES a sentence from the run, never a pick token alone.
method.cost: total_tokens and duration_ms recorded per run, beside the pass-rate delta.
method.staleness: Any change to the description, or to the tool calls the body writes, re-runs the whole set before the next release.

last_measured.run: 2026-08-15 fan-out, against the PRE-rewrite description and this same 20-case set
